title: An Irrationality Measure for Catalan's Constant
summary: Building on OpenAI's proof that Catalan's constant $G=\sum_{j\ge0}(-1)^j/(2j+1)^2$ is irrational, we prove $|G-a/b|>b^{-878}$ for every integer $a$ and every sufficiently large integer $b$. Thus $\mu(G)\le878$. Using Chebyshev's estimates for final prime selection gives $2\,632$; denominator and content asymptotics still use PNT. We change the determinant parameters, obtaining a $20N$ matrix and a polynomial of degree at most $18N$.
